verdict.rationale: Ramp documents receipt capture tied to card swipes: it captures the receipt, fills memos and categories, and lets employees submit via SMS, Slack, Teams or the mobile app. Reimbursements support "snap a picture," and the CLI offers receipt upload and attach against transactions. Its 99% OCR claim is documented only for bill-pay invoices, so receipt-level OCR and automatic matching are implied rather than explicit. Missing for 10: email-forwarding receipt capture, explicit OCR of employee receipts, documented auto-matching of a photographed receipt to the correct card transaction, independent or hands-on corroboration.
